resources.string: "Now playing, server scrobbling and offline queue"
"Enabled by default. Sends only to your configured Subsonic servers. Their configured scrobbler handles external services. Local files and radio are excluded. Disabling clears pending reports."
"A listen counts after half the track or four minutes of actual playback, whichever is earlier. Pauses, buffering and seeking ahead do not count."
"Offline listens retain their original time. Up to 10,000 pending entries are kept for 90 days; older entries are discarded. Live now-playing reports are not queued."
"Discard unsent listens? Local listening history and server records will remain."
"Pending reports retry automatically when the server is reachable. Delivery to external scrobblers depends on server configuration and their age limits."
